title: Vibrant Monsoon Australian Lamb Skewers
description: A flavorful Australian dish featuring lamb skewers marinated in a mixture of vin-santo, mustard, and herbs, perfect for a monsoon evening. This sugar-free-friendly recipe is a great option for a healthy dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together vin-santo, mustard, olive oil, rosemary, garlic, salt, and pepper to make the marinade.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and toss to coat, then cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Soak the skewers in brine for 30 minutes to prevent them from burning during cooking.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional rosemary if desired.
